summary: Iter189s follow-up — Coach exercise-content picker read/write fix VERIFIED. 10/10 UI tests PASS. Previously-broken bug (backfilled TIMER exercises showing REPS as active) is now fixed: picker reads detail.logging_type_override ?? detail.logging_type ?? null and reflects TIMER on load for backfilled rows (Plank, Side plank, Easy Run). Dual-endpoint PATCH write (override endpoint + exercise-content endpoint) fires as designed. Persistence verified on reopen for both directions (REPS→TIMER, TIMER→REPS). Create Exercise Modal with TIMER selected persists TIMER on reopen (proves both write-from-create and read-in-detail work together). No React Native / Expo issues found in this change. Only pre-existing dev-mode console warnings (shadow*/textShadow* deprecations, expo-notifications web listener) — not part of this fix scope.
critical_code_review_comments: exercise-content.tsx is 1400+ lines — consider extracting LoggingTypeOverrideRow, SlotPicker, ImgSlot into /src/components/coach/ for maintainability (not blocking, pre-existing).
seed_data_creation: Created & archived a throwaway exercise TEST_TimerCheck_<epoch> to verify create→reopen TIMER persistence.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test verified via computed backgroundColor (rgba brand-red rgb(163,24,46) = active) since React Native's accessibilityState.selected does NOT render as `aria-selected` on the web DOM in this Expo build. Use getComputedStyle for future active-state checks on Pressable buttons. Exercises used: 'Side plank' (override=None, logging_type=timer → main bug case), 'Easy Run' (same), 'Plank' (override=timer already), 'Back Squat' (default REPS strength).
